standard_references.evidence: Target package standard; SDMX 2.0 formal DSD term is Key Family.
Used for common concept reuse: FREQ, REF_AREA, TIME_PERIOD, OBS_VALUE, UNIT_MEASURE, OBS_STATUS, SEX, AGE, ACTIVITY.
Candidate source for CL_FREQ, CL_SEX, CL_OBS_STATUS and CL_SEASONAL_ADJUST; exact versions and memberships not confirmed in supplied evidence.
Authoritative geography source; synthetic/local Northland, Centralia and South Coast not confirmed as UN M49 areas.
Candidate source for ISIC, CPC, COICOP, crop and product review; no supplied evidence confirms equivalence/version for local labels.
Candidate source for education-level review; no confirmed code table/version in supplied evidence.
Candidate for currency codes; agriculture and prices reports use unnamed local currency so no ISO code can be assigned.
Candidate source for report metadata concepts: compiling organisation, methodology, source data, caveats, revisions and confidentiality.

limitations: This reusable aggregate covers 01_sdmx_20_population_full_case.xml, 02_sdmx_20_consumer_prices_full_case.xml, 03_sdmx_21_labour_market_full_case.xml, 04_sdmx_21_external_trade_full_case.xml, example_01_labour_market.pdf, example_02_health_system.pdf, example_03_education.pdf, example_04_agriculture.pdf and example_05_prices_consumption.pdf.
STRUCTURE_ID is a template-only routing/control field, not an SDMX observation component. It replaces legacy aliases DATA_STRUCTURE_ROUTING, SDMX_KEY_FAMILY and DATAFLOW_OR_KEY_FAMILY.

Mechanically imported XML structures are preserved separately as KF_POPULATION, KF_XML_CPI, KF_XML_LABOUR_MARKET and KF_XML_EXTERNAL_TRADE. Their codelist versions and source URLs were not stated in XML and must be verified before production dissemination.
Do not merge XML CPI PRODUCT_GROUP with PDF prices CONSUMPTION_DIVISION; do not merge XML labour SEX with PDF labour/education sex lists; keep external-trade PARTNER distinct from REF_AREA/reporter.
No local codelists or codes are created here. Local codes cited must be governed in corresponding codelist artefacts.

Health and education annual FREQ remains unresolved against SDMX CL_FREQ. Agriculture and prices A/M mappings are candidates requiring version/code confirmation. Labour PDF quarterly/monthly uses a local staging list.
Northland, Centralia and South Coast remain report-specific local areas in labour, health and agriculture until common geographic governance is confirmed.

Labour Total sex and education Total sex are report-specific; labour Total must not be derived by summing Women and Men, and education Total is allowed only for enrollment rows with unresolved inclusion rules.
Labour activities, health causes, education levels, agriculture crops/fertilizer products and prices consumption divisions require authoritative classification-version review before external mapping.
Agriculture and prices local-currency units cannot be mapped to ISO 4217 because the source reports do not name the currency.
No REF_AREA is stated for PDF labour vacancies, PDF education observations or PDF prices/consumption observations; geography must not be invented.
Reference metadata fields are report/dataset metadata-set handoff fields, not observation-level SDMX dimensions.
